title: Pairs cannot be deposited when the externalAssetVault has not been set
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  The `FraxlendPairCore._repayAsset()` function has this check before making external calls to the external vault:  ```solidity         if (address(externalAssetVault) != address(0)) { ```  However, this check is not included in `FraxlendPairCore._deposit()` before it makes an external call to the `externalAssetVault`.  This means that depositing will always revert when the `externalAssetVault` has not been set, so lending pairs cannot function independently of the lending asset vault.  ## Recommendations  In `_deposit()`,
